scope: Adoption in one manager materialization slot (I09). Historical callers may still receive an old Promise result.

stateVariables.state,originSlot,originG,starts: Per-request tokens rather than JS objects.

initialState: New manager, empty slot, generation zero.
assumptions: Atomic commit/clear after await. No concurrent managers or filesystem effects.

safety.ReceiptCurrentGeneration: Stored receipt belongs to current generation.
safety.NoStaleAdoption: An old completion cannot mutate the active slot.
safety.OldFailureCannotClearNew: An older rejection preserves newer work.

liveness: None: no caller or external-process completion guarantee.
fairness: None; terminal stuttering represents quiescence only.

bounds.dimensions: 1 advance and provider replan, 2 or 3 attempts.
bounds.pruning: None: no state/action constraints, symmetry or view filtering.

counterexamples: Late-receipt removes three guards together; never infer that each is necessary.
empiricalVerification: Run preflight.spec.ts (in-flight materialization and replacement cases).
